entries.def:
ἱππεύς, -έως (on accusative pl., -εῖς, ν. BI., § 8, 2; Thack., Gr., 148), ὁ 
(ἵππος), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָשׁ ;] 
a horseman: Act.23.23, 32.†
(AS)

ἱππικός, -ή, -όν
(ἵππος), [in LXX: 1Ma.15.33, 3Ma.1.1 * ;] 
of a horse or of horsemen, equestrian; as subst., τὸ ἱ (sc. στράτευμα), cavalry: Heb.9.16.†
(AS)

ἵππος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for סוּס, sometimes for פָּרָשׁ, רֶכֶב ;] 
a horse: Jas.3.3, Rev.6.2 ff. Rev.9.7 ff. Rev.14.20; 18.13; 19.11 ff,†
(AS)

ἶρις, -ιδος, ἡ 
[in LXX: Exo.30.24 (קִדָּה)*, (קֶשֶׁת, Gen.9.13, Ezk.1.28, is rendered by τόξον) ;] 
__1. Iris, the messenger of the gods. 
__2. a rain­bow or halo: Rev.4.3; 10.1. 
__3. The plant Iris (cf. Ex., l.with).†
(AS)

Ἰσαάκ
(in MSS. sometimes -σάκ; cf. Deiss., BS, 189; Thack., Gr., 100), ὁ 
indecl. 
(in FlJ, Ἴσακος, -ου), (Heb. יִצְחָק), 
Isaac (Gen.17.19, al.): Mat.1.2, Rom.9.10, al 
(AS)

ἰσάγγελος -ον
(ἴσος, ἄγγελος), 
like or equal to angels: Luk.20.36.†
(AS)

Ἰσσαχάρ (Rec. Ἰσαχ-, Ἰσασχ- (Elz.), T, -άχαρ), ὁ indecl. (FlJ, Ἰσάχαρις, Ἰσάσχ-) (Heb. יִשָּׂשכָר, Gen.30.18), 
Issachar: Rev.7.7.†
(AS)

- to know, see, understand 
Occurs as Perfect with Present meaning

εἰμί, 
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be. 
__I. As substantive verb. 
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17.28, Jhn.1.1; 8.58; 17.5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1.4, 8; 4.8; 11.17; 16.5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4.17, 1Co.1.28. 
__2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24.3, Mrk.14.2; 15.42, Luk.21.23, Jhn.4.6, 23;…

ἰσκαριώθ, ὁ indecl. 
(Mrk.3.19; 14.10, Luk.6.16, elsewhere -ιώτης; V. infr.) and Ἰσκαριώτης, -ου (Heb. prob. קִרְיָא אִישׁ; see Swete, Mk., 319), 
Iscariot: surname of Judas, ll. with supr., also Mat.10.4; 26.14, Mrk.14.43 (WH, R, omit), Luk.22.3, Jhn.12.4; 13.2; 14.22; of his father Simon, Jhn.6.71; 13.26.†
(AS)
